Auto-Pack Template Form ID: (~/?ScreenId=TC301000 TC301000)
Auto-pack templates let you define special packaging rules that can then be assigned to Acumatica customers. You can define packaging rules by Pack Quantity and can set rules to package multiple items to a carton. You can create as many auto-pack templates as you'd like. They’ll need to be defined to the customer in the Customer Settings within the Sales Order module under the heading "Other" prior to packaging the shipments.
Acumatica uses the Box No value to determine if items should be packaged together. For example, if two AACOMPUT01 items and one AALEGO500 item will fit in a single package, but AAPOWERAID must be shipped in its own package a template could be created as shown below.

TrueCommerce Tab
The TrueCommerce tab on the Bills and Adjustments screen lists the fields that were originally passed from Transaction Manager to Acumatica during the Bills create.

Login Form ID: (~/?ScreenId=TC103000 TC103000)
User must connect their Acumatica to API and Foundry using their Foundry user credentials. TrueCommerce will check the SKU permission, get all the trading partner names and templates for the customer’s tenant based on their login.(The customer must have the labeling SKU as part of their Transaction Manager instance.)
The following is the steps to connect Acumatica to API and Foundry.
1. Select the Environment(Should be set to Production unless something is being tested in Staging)
2. Enter Foundry User Name
3. Enter Foundry Password
4. Enter Tenant
5. Select Transaction Status, Report or Labeling
6. Click Sign in

Shipments Form ID: (~/?ScreenId=SO302000 SO302000)
Document Details Tab TrueCommerce has added the PO Line Number as well as three User Defined Fields to the Document Details tab of the Sales Order screen. These three fields provide storage location to which you can transfer data from Transaction Manager to Acumatica.
As part of this integration to Acumatica when transactions are exported from Transaction Manager to Acumatica, fields are passed to Acumatica with data that Acumatica doesn’t normally store.
Packages Tab In order to support for ASNs, TrueCommerce added the ability to buildout packages in Acumatica.
TrueCommerce Tab TrueCommerce UDF: The TrueCommerce UDF section on the Shipments screen lists the fields that were originally passed from Transaction Manager to Acumatica during the sales order creation. With the exception of the Purchase Order Number field, there currently is no standard matching field within Acumatica for the EDI Store Number, EDI Distribution Center and ASN Type. Therefore, the TrueCommerce UDF section has been added to the Integration with Acumatica to store this data. Additionally, five user defined fields have also been added to this section as the storage location to which customers can transfer data from Transaction Manager to Acumatica.
Ship-from Address: The Ship From Address for label printing can be set when creating the sales order during the PO export from TM. It will be brought to Shipment from Sales Order.
Transaction Status: Support is added to provide visibility within Acumatica to see when documents have been sent to the Trading Partner.

Customizations TrueCommerce has made modifications to the user interface in order to accommodate order information that may not be traditionally stored within standard Acumatica’s screens. These modifications allow for the compliancy data points to be include on outbound documents to trading partners. These data points can be created during the export of an order or through manual entry.
New Functionality Sales Order
On the Sales Order screen TrueCommerce has added a new tab titled “TrueCommerce” which holds critical order data points such as the Purchase Order Number, EDI Store Number, EDI Distribution Center as well as five additional user defined fields (UDFs) that can mapped from an inbound document to Acumatica.
Invoice

Auto-Pack Template
Auto-Pack Template screen (located under TrueCommerce on the Sales Orders menu) allows you to define special packaging rules that can then be assigned to Acumatica customers. You can define packaging rules by Pack Quantity and can set rules to package multiple items to a carton.
Item Package Settings
The Item Package Settings screen (located under TrueCommerce on the Sales Orders menu) is where you define the Pack Quantity for each Acumatica item that will be ordered and packaged for your trading partners.
Customer Settings
The Customer Settings screen (located under TrueCommerce on the Sales Orders menu) provides the ability to assign an Auto-Pack Template (created in the Auto-Pack Template screen) to specific customer(s) to be used when creating packages for Shipments.
Process Shipment Automation
The Process Shipment Automation screen (located under TrueCommerce on the Sales Orders menu) allows for the creation of multiple shipments at once.

The Transaction Status Settings window provides the ability for the customer who want to use the Transaction Status Indicator to configure the default date range for the Transactions. Users must connect their Acumatica to Indicator API and Foundry using their Foundry user credentials.
Process Purchase Order Acknowledgement
Process Purchase Order Acknowledgement allows to check if the sales orders you selected have been sent to your trading partners as a Purchase Order Acknowledgement.
Process Warehouse Shipping Order

Process Shipment

Process Invoice AR

Process Invoice SO

Process Purchase Order

Labeling Settings
The Labeling Settings window provides the ability for the customer who want to print Label for the shipments to configure the Label page size(Labels are split into batches of maximum of 100 labels per PDF), Label log Tracing and the number of days to log within,
Labeling Customer Settings
The Labeling Customer Settings window provides the ability to set the label partner, template, GS1-128 and label field maps for each customer to print labels.
Ship-from Address
A ship from address must be set in order to publish on the label. You need to specify for the customer, what address will print on the labels as the Ship-from address(TC105000),
Batch Label Printing
Batch Label Printing allows to batch print the labels for the shipment you selected.
Labeling Log
This form is to show the label logs if you fail to print a label,
Login
You must connect you Acumatica to API and Foundry using their Foundry user credentials. TrueCommerce will check the SKU permission, get all the trading partner names and templates for the customer’s tenant based on their login.(The customer must have the labeling sku as part of their Transaction Manager instance)
API Urls
